lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: There's a beach here.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, this should work nicely.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Is Gluttony here?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yeah. It should be underground, within a 10km radius.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: 10 kilometers?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: How are we supposed to find it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How do you think? We need to lure it out.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: But how?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: By using the beach, for starters.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Setting up here will allow us to minimize the amount of Raptures that could swarm us.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Since Gluttony reacts to strong energy sources,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'd say it stands to reason that's what we have to use to lure it, don't you?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Do we have something that's capable of producing that much energy?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... We do.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Both of you, listen to me carefully.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll lure out Gluttony.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni, once I get it to stop,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: you need to make sure it doesn't close its mouth.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You need to hold it open for as long as you can, however you can, until Mori and Siren are out of there.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: There's a chance they might not be able to escape through Gluttony's breathing hole.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: While Yuni's doing that, Mori,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: you need to take the E2 Crystals and hop inside its mouth.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: The main reason Siren refuses to come out is that

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: she intends on sacrificing herself in order to eliminate the energy inside the AA Pillar.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: In other words,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If we can't convince Siren to leave of her own accord, we can't save her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's why your role is the most crucial, Mori.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Not only do you have to go back inside Gluttony and plant the E2 Crystals onto its core,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: you also have to meet up with Siren

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: and convince her to come out.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You can do it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: No, you need to do it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We came here to save a life, not lose our own.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... You're right.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I have to do it.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I have to save her, no matter what. That's why I asked for your help.
Mori looks at Yuni and Mihara.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You both are risking your lives for my sake. I won't fail you.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, you've become a real trustworthy ally, Mori.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't make fun of me when I'm being serious!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All right, all right. Anyway, shall we get started?
Mihara walks forward.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo!
Yuni urgently grabs Mihara's hand.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, Yuni?

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Coo coo.
Yuni shakes her head at Mihara.
Though she can't explain why, her instincts are telling her to stop Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni...

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo...
Yuni shakes her head desperately, pleading for Mihara not to go through with this.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I would never leave you behind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We promised each other that

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: we would truly see each other, that we would feel each other's pain,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: and that we would atone for our sins together.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Coo.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I haven't forgotten that promise, and I intend to keep it.
Yuni and Mihara lock eyes.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Trust me, and wait.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Failure is not an option.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!
Yuni lets go of Mihara's hand.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Thank you, Yuni.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll be back.
Mihara steps forward again, leaving Yuni behind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Code release.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Activate all cores to their limit.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Initiate fusion.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Recognition complete.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Activate all cores in body to their limit.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: ERROR.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Reaction error, fusion unsuccess...

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: *Bzzz* *Bzzzzzz*

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: UNLOCK CODE: D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Activate all cores in body to their limit.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Initiating fusion.
*Kreeeeee*
The area near Mihara's core starts to glow red.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Mihara!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Arrrgghhh!
Mihara curls up, unable to withstand the pain.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Put what where?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Mana.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You did receive what I sent, didn't you?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I believe so.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Are you talking about this?
Mana points to a palm-sized black box.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: That's it. Looks like it arrived safely.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I was worried because the elevator wasn't working properly.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I suppose sending something small doesn't pose any issues.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I would like you to insert this into my body.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: It's a special gift I prepared for Mihara,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: to get her stronger much more quickly.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Tuck it safe and sound beside her Nikke core, if you would.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I would have loved to handle it myself, what with this being the first experiment and all,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: but as you know, I don't exactly have freedom of movement right now.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I'm still not following.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Mihara was the one who contacted me,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: quite eagerly, I must say.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: She told me she requires additional strength in order to fight Gluttony.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Given that she couldn't utilize her current body's ability to its fullest, she wanted my help.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: And to that end, she agreed to become my test subject.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Mihara!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: That's why I prepared this little doohickey for her.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: It's quite risky, to be sure, but if you want to enhance a Nikke's abilities in one go,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: it's the best option available.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: So it's meant to enhance a Nikke's abilities,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: yet you're having me insert it beside her core separately.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Is this a Rapture core?!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You're familiar with the ins and outs of Nikke bodies.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I'm sure you can insert it next to her current core easily enough, right?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: This is incredibly dangerous! If I insert this inside her, the Nikke core could...

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Do you remember your promise from long ago?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You said you would help me the next time I wanted to do something good.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Well, now's that time.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I can't leave the Ark at the moment,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: and Mihara needs to fortify her strength straight away.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: That leaves us with you, Mana. You're the only one who can do this.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: You call inserting this inside a Nikke a good thing?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Of course. I'm giving a Nikke who wants to be stronger the power she deserves.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: What's more benevolent than that?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: But a Nikke and Rapture core can't exist together.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: You of all people should know that a Nikke's core...

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Yes yes, I know.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Nikke cores have a barrier which prevents them from reacting with other cores.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: But what if you could break past that barrier?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: What? Are you telling me you figured out a way? How?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Hehe, that's my little secret.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If I told you, you might have to get sent somewhere awfully dangerous.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You don't want that, do you?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Now then, be a good girl, would you?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Don't let your curiosity get the best of you. Don't peek inside the box, and just put it inside her, okay?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What's this "barrier" you're both talking about?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Nikke cores have a safety mechanism

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: which makes it so they can't react with other cores.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Even if it's two Nikke cores in one body, it prevents them from interacting.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: It would also prevent Rapture cores from devouring the Nikke core,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: and vice versa.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You mean Nikke and Rapture cores can consume each other?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Yes. A clear example of that is Core Dust.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: It can distill a Rapture core down to its essence and use that to stimulate growth within a Nikke's own core.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Jien!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Oh dear, there I go again, running my mouth.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If you knew any more about this, Mihara, you'd never be allowed up on the surface again. So I'll stop there.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: On the other hand, it's nice knowing the stakes, don't you think?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Of course. It's important to know these things.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Now then, Mihara, once that core is implanted into your body,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: all the abilities you previously couldn't draw out from your body will fully awaken.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If there are no changes after the surgery, then it means your body itself is defective.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: However, I can quite confidently say that

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: my sister is the best of the best when it comes to building Nikkes,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: so I'm sure you'll become much stronger, Mihara.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: That is, if you can endure the pain.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Every prior test subject has died because they couldn't withstand the pain.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You, however, said you'd be willing to do anything,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: so I'm sure you'll be able to endure it, won't you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Of course.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Hehe, I can't wait to see how it turns out!
*Grit*
Mihara clenches her teeth.
Just as Jien warned, a pain beyond anything imaginable courses through Mihara's body.
Her vision repeatedly turns red, fades away, and then comes back.
*Beep* *Crackle*

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. System error.
*Crackle*

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Core response error.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Core resonance activation. Connecting code *bzz* error.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Core type... *bzz* match... *bzzz* error.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Barrier... *bzz* reactivation required...
A series of warning sounds and error messages blare out.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I know... you're not used to a core like this...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but you've got to accept it!
Mihara closes her eyes and begins to suppress the sensations surging through her.
Inside her body, near her core, is a searing heat, like a blazing inferno.
The conflagration expands,
and begins to engulf Mihara's own core.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Barrier... *bzz* reactivation required...

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: Warning. Barrier... *bzz* reactivation required...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Urggghh!
Countless warning sounds echo in her head.
Mihara's movements, senses, and everything slowly become consumed by the fire.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If this continues... my body will...!
*Kreeeeee*
Mihara's body begins glowing even redder.
The inside of her core boils like a massive fireball,
a volcano on the verge of eruption.
As it rages on, her consciousness drifts further and further away.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: *Gasp*!
It's then that Mihara realizes:
The moment she is completely consumed by the flames,
she, as she knows herself, would cease to exist.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Cooo!!!
From somewhere she can't see, someone is screaming.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Cooo!!!
A familiar voice cries out in agony.
It screams, imploring her not to leave her behind again.
Who is it?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Cooo!!!
Who's calling me?

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Mihara!

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo!
Yuni and Mihara lock eyes.
Yuni's eyes tremble with fear, terrified of losing Mihara once again.
Her eyes beg Mihara to keep her promise.
Mihara can't let those eyes be filled with despair again.
*Grit*
Mihara bites down on her cheek.
*Grit*
Harder.
The sharp pain in her mouth pulls Mihara back to life.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo...!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll accept it all.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: The pain. The sorrow.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: The desperation. All of it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll take it all in.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Cooo.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I will never abandon you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: This time, no matter what, I will bring you back on the right path.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If we die, we die together, and if we live, we live together!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I will claim this power as my own in order to protect our bond, no matter how great the pain.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll do this so that no one will ever take you away from me again!
Light begins to radiate from Mihara's body.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Mihara...?
*Clank*
A purplish light, dark enough almost to be black, burst forth from Mihara's core,
and chain-like patterns of the same color spread all over her body.
Mihara recognizes the changes in her body.
She now realizes how to awaken the sensations contained within all living things.
No matter how much larger her target is,
no matter how overwhelmingly powerful they are,
or how much pain they can endure,
none of it matters anymore.
So long as her foes are alive
and connected to her via these “chains” on her body,
she knows that she can now feel their pain as well.
She can endure any amount of suffering they inflict upon her. Of that she is certain.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Such power!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: My arms could be ripped off. My entire body could be smashed to a pulp,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And I would enjoy it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: There's no limit to the pain that I can now endure.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How thrilling! Oh, the fun I'm going to have!
*Clank*
With the clinking sound of chain links, the patterns on her body fade and then disappear into her skin.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: In order to establish a connection with these chains...
Mihara lifts the pendulum attached to the end of her whip.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All I have to do is stab the enemy with this?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, Syuen was right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If this is the kind of ability she originally envisioned,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: then the sensory exchange I was capable of before could only be considered a failure.
Mihara looks at Yuni and Mori, who are watching her anxiously.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I've never felt this powerful in my life. Almost omnipotent.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And considering how much energy I just released,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: it's bound to come calling.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Gah!
*Rummmble*!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Everyone, back up!
*Boommm*!
Gluttony emerges from the ground.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Gluttony!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now that our guest has accepted my invitation,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: let's go, Yuni.
Mihara steps forward,
resembling a female prison warden about to weave a massive prison for her prey.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let the hunt begin.
